newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-UEFA HITS INTER WITH HEAVY FINE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UEFA HITS INTER WITH HEAVY FINE.

text.p: Internazionale were fined a total of 159,000 Swiss francs ($108,000) by UEFA on Friday over a series of incidents during the second leg of their UEFA Cup final against Schalke 04 last May.
The series of fines included 125,000 francs ($85,300) for improper conduct by the Milan club's supporters at Stadio Giuseppe Meazza.
Inter were also fined lesser amounts for selling tickets for a non-German section at the stadium in Germany, causing a security risk and accepting an advertising board for a religious sect.
Schalke were fined 25,000 francs ($17,000) for improper conduct by their supporters at the same match.
European soccer's governing body also fined Paris St Germain 30,000 francs ($20,400) and Manchester United 10,000 ($6,820) for improper conduct by their supporters.
